paragraphs.text:
1
Ghost Blade. This knife may hit immaterial targets and targets
hit only by magic weapons such as ghosts. The blade strikes
them at +1 and inflicts 2 damage. Against other targets, it
counts as a regular, damage 1 knife. It counts as 1 carried item.

2
Hell Chain. This length of rusty chain is imbued with the pain
and suffering of tortured souls. Each use costs you a L5 Will
save (lose 1 Sanity if you fail) but inflicts 1 automatic damage
against any target including spirits and demons. Once the
chain has inflicted a total of 6 hits, it turns into a heap of rust
and dried blood. It counts as 1 carried item.

3
The Book of Hypnos. If you spend 1 XP, with this grimoire you
learn to cast a spell that makes a single, living target (not
Undead or Artificial, not an animated doll) fall asleep if you
perform a Magic roll against the target’s L. You may try to use
the spell as many times as you want until you succeed. Once
you succeed, you may not use the spell again for the rest of
the current game. The book counts as 1 carried item.

4
Holy Bullets. These 2d6 bullets with holy inscriptions may be
used with a pistol only. They inflict 2 damage against demons
and vampires. When you wound a demon or vampire with
these bullets, roll d6. If you roll higher than their L, the
wounded creature will flee.

5
Blessed Candle. You may burn this candle to recover 1 Sanity
or remove a curse. You may also use it in any ritual requiring
candles. Negligible weight.
6 Amulet. Wearing this amulet gives you +1 to all saves vs.
magic. Negligible weight.
